notes.title: Updated: scenes, new levels, tools, toys and pieces.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27218422/eb6478911d24636c7f5af859614969597ac8c4a3.jpg[/img][b]DominoCraft VR[/b] got a big update that not only add a lots of content but also polish VR interaction and experience. So you can craft more creative domino chains conveniently and comfortablely. 

[b]Changes:[/b]
 [*]Polish scenes’ light and animations.
 [*]Polish new handy UI.
 [*]Polish new background music.
 [*]Polish new controller models.
 [*]Add a new tool : painter.
 [*]Add two more scene with 12 new levels.
 [*]Add 6 new toys, 5 new pieces, 2 new patterns.
 [*]Add unlock feature.

Enjoy DominoCraftːsteamhappyː.
